requirement: A check with missing, malformed, or stale evidence must fail nonzero and report all evidence failures with the requirement IDs and instructions to revalidate using the revalidate skill.
justification: Scenarios: missing, malformed, stale requirement and stale excerpt; multiple failed requirements in one invocation. validate attaches ID/revalidate-skill instructions to every problem, run collects all failures, and main exits nonzero. Tests assert nonzero status, empty stdout, both IDs and aggregate counts. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions.
